note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate, soldier and monomorphic worker are described; postclypeus measurements follow those of Akhtar (1975); synonymy, literature citations, distribution and figure numbers are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown to reddish brown; antennae uniformly yellow to light yellowish brown; labrum yellowish brown to light brown; mandibles dark reddish brown, paler at base; pronotum pale yellow; legs and abdomen creamy white. Pilosity of head sparse, of body denser. Body length 3.75–4.40 mm. Head capsule oval, narrowed anteriorly; length to base of mandibles 1.00–1.31 mm, maximum width 0.90–1.22 mm, width at base of mandibles 0.55–0.82 mm, maximum width/head length 0.894–0.930, width at base of mandibles/maximum width 0.60–0.630. Antennae 15–16-segmented, segment 3 or 4 shortest. Labrum lingulate, broadly rounded anteriorly. Mandibles sickle-shaped, apex weakly incurved, slightly longer than half head length, 0.62–0.74 mm long, mandible length/head length 0.533. Left mandible with one sharp, anteriorly directed tooth in the apical third, tooth 0.16–0.25 mm from apex, tooth distance/mandible length 0.292. Right mandible with one small tooth, slightly below the level of the left mandibular tooth. Postmentum arched, convex laterally, slightly longer than wide, widest at middle, 0.49–0.72 mm long, 0.39–0.59 mm maximum width. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin weakly to distinctly notched, posterior margin weakly concave, 0.33–0.49 mm long, 0.65–0.88 mm wide.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Monomorphic. Head capsule and postclypeus light yellowish brown; antennae uniformly yellow; legs and body creamy white. Pilosity of head and body rather dense. Body length 3.0–3.30 mm. Head capsule subcircular, length to base of mandibles 0.95–0.98 mm, maximum width 1.13–1.15 mm. Antennae 17-segmented, segments 3 and 4 subequal in length, segment 5 shortest. Postclypeus inflated, hairy, less than half as long as wide, 0.18–0.19 mm long, 0.55 mm wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped, 0.35 mm long, 0.58–0.63 mm wide; anterior and posterior margins both weakly concave.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark reddish brown, paler near postclypeus; postclypeus slightly paler than head capsule; antennae dark reddish brown; pronotum dark reddish brown, with yellowish brown T-shaped mark and small ocellus-like shoulder spots. Pilosity of head dense, of both short and long hairs; pilosity of postclypeus and pronotum similar to that of head capsule. Head subcircular, length to base of mandibles 1.61–1.76 mm, maximum width including compound eyes 2.21–2.47 mm. Fontanelle small, circular, situated slightly behind the level of the ocelli. Compound eyes subcircular, maximum diameter 0.49–0.55 mm, minimum diameter 0.46–0.49 mm, at a distance from the lower margin of the head far less than their minimum diameter (0.18–0.19 mm). Ocelli broadly oval, long diameter 0.19–0.22 mm, short diameter 0.14–0.17 mm, separated from compound eye by more than their long diameter (0.29–0.33 mm). Antennae 19-segmented, segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 4 or subequal to it. Postclypeus inflated, less than half as long as wide, 0.41–0.42 mm long, 0.90–0.93 mm wide. Pronotum narrower than head, anterior and posterior margins indistinctly concave, 1.06–1.12 mm long, 1.95–2.13 mm wide.
